name: Cultist's Dinner
source:
Dakota has been worshipping eldritch beings and using the powers of occult for years now. But despite all of that, he can’t make a goddamn dinner.

Play as Dakota while he tries to make a meal, and also find out why it’s a terrible idea to mix cooking with the occult.

[From [url=https://heraldicscriptures.itch.io/cultists-dinner]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
达科他多年来一直崇拜邪恶的生物并使用神秘的力量。但尽管如此，他还是做不到一顿该死的晚餐。

扮演达科他尝试做饭，并找出为什么将烹饪与神秘结合起来是一个糟糕的主意。

[来自[url=https://heraldicscriptures.itch.io/cultists-dinner]Itch.io[/url]]
